results.description: Alternative trading system katy.thorson Fri, 09/11/2026 - 13:23 Alternative trading system An alternative trading system (ATS) is an execution platform that brings together buyers and sellers of securities, similar to how orders are matched on an exchange. The system operator must be a licensed broker-dealer registered under SEC Rule ATS and must comply with various conduct and reporting requirements. (0926-NPF3)
